response.overview: An experimental short film exploring ageing, memory and the relationship between the body and time. Through movement and muscle memory, an elderly woman revisits fragments of her youth, revealing how our past experiences remain embedded within us long after the moments themselves have passed. Inspired by conversations with an elderly reading group at a local library, the film challenges the tendency to overlook older people as individuals, instead celebrating their identities, histories and experiences. Created in collaboration with my grandmother and sister, the film uses physical expression as a visual language to explore nostalgia, womanhood and the enduring connection between our younger and older selves.
response.tagline: The body remembers what time forgets.
response.title: Quiet days
